pages.title: Sextic fourfolds with an involution
pages.description: The problem, notation, and how the chapters fit together.

pages.title: 1. From invariant cohomology to rational certificates
pages.description: From invariant cohomology to the key equation, normalization, and support.

pages.title: 2. Algebraic constructions and residue transport
pages.description: Cofactor transport, cyclic suspension, closed currents, and variation of rational primitives.

pages.title: 2A. Binary sextics and torsion contacts
pages.description: Genus-two three-torsion, Wronskian spanning, and an explicit construction on a binary-block family.

pages.title: 3. Geometric support, finite groups and surface fibrations
pages.description: Gysin maps, finite-group projectors, Fano and surface fibrations, and supported projectors in families.

pages.title: 3A. Split sextics, elliptic contraction and the K3 remainder
pages.description: Elliptic companions, quotient resolutions, and Kuga–Satake support.

pages.title: 3B. Weighted threefolds and two-reflection sextics
pages.description: Norm-contact curves, Abel–Jacobi residues, finite-jet spanning, and two-reflection support.

pages.title: 3C. Quadratic nets and pair correspondences
pages.description: Four-point fibers, six-line incidence, Fano resolvents and divisor support for quadratic-net sextics.

pages.title: 4. Families, representations and deformation
pages.description: Coefficient spaces, cyclic-six descent, invariant sectors and generic-target propagation.

pages.title: 5. Computing and checking certificates
pages.description: Complete coefficient systems, exactification, and the limits of numerical evidence.
